heading: 童蒙先習 · 君臣有義 (님근과신해의이심이라) · Between ruler and subject there is righteousness · 君臣有義 1 … 君臣有義 5

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 序論 · Introduction · 序論 1 … 序論 4

items.text: Be kind to your son and love him with a father's heart.
items.quote: 父慈 — the father is kind

items.text: Be filial to your father; honour and serve him with devotion.
items.quote: 子孝 — the son is filial

items.text: Be harmonious with your wife and live with her in peace.
items.quote: 夫和 — the husband is harmonious

items.text: Be obedient to your husband and follow his lead.
items.quote: 婦順 — the wife is obedient

items.text: Be friendly and loving toward your younger siblings.
items.quote: 兄友 — the elder brother is friendly

items.text: Respect your elder siblings and treat them with deference.
items.quote: 弟恭 — the younger brother is respectful

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 御製童蒙先習序 · Royal Preface of King Yeongjo (1742) · 御製童蒙先習序 1 … 御製童蒙先習序 2

items.text: Be filial to your parents, for filial piety is first among the five relations.
items.citation: Dongmong Seonseup, Royal Preface of King Yeongjo (1742), 1
items.quote: 孝於親然後에 忠於君하며 — Be filial to your parents, then loyal to the ruler.

items.text: Respect and obey your elder brother as befitting a younger brother.
items.citation: Dongmong Seonseup, Royal Preface of King Yeongjo (1742), 1
items.quote: 弟於兄然後에 敬于長하니 — Be brotherly to your elder brother, then you will respect elders.

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 跋 · Afterword by Song Si-yeol (1670) · 跋 1 … 跋 6

items.text: From their first schooling, give them clear instruction in the names and meanings of moral principles so they may practice them.
items.quote: 古人之敎 自小學之時 已有白直分明訓說 — The ancients' teaching, from the time of elementary learning, already had clear and distinct instructions.

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 父子有親 (아비와ᄌᆞ식이친홈이이심이라) · Between father and son there is affection · 父子有親 1 … 父子有親 4

items.text: Raise him: give him life and nurture his growth.
items.quote: 生而育之 — give birth and raise him.

items.text: Love him: cherish him as your own flesh and blood.
items.quote: 愛而教之 — love and teach him.

items.text: Teach him what is right and keep him from evil.
items.quote: 教之以義方，弗納於邪 — teach him with what is right and do not let him go into evil.

items.text: Serve and obey him: follow his instructions and respect his authority.
items.quote: 奉而承之 — serve and obey him.

items.text: Honor and support him, even if he is not kind to you.
items.quote: 孝而養之 — be filial and support him; 父雖不慈，子不可以不孝 — even if the father is not loving, the son cannot be unfilial.

items.text: Gently remonstrate with him so that he does not bring disgrace upon himself or the family.
items.quote: 柔聲以諫，不使得罪於鄕黨州閭 — with gentle voice remonstrate, not allowing him to offend the village and neighborhood.

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 朋友有信 · Between friends there is trust · 朋友有信 1 … 朋友有信 4

items.text: Admonish your friend for his good with trust; give loyal counsel and guide him well, but if he does not accept, stop.
items.quote: 要當責善以信，切切偲偲，忠告而善道之，不可則止

items.text: In your companionship, pursue mutual improvement like cutting and polishing; do not merely joke and play, or the friendship will not last.
items.quote: 不以切磋琢磨爲相與，但以歡狎戱謔爲相親則安能久而不疎乎

items.text: Respect your friend even after long acquaintance; do not let familiarity breed contempt.
items.quote: 晏子與人交，久而敬之

items.text: Be trustworthy to your friends, so that they trust you and you gain the trust of those above.
items.quote: 不信乎朋友，不獲乎上矣

items.text: Obey your parents; without this you will not be trusted by your friends.
items.quote: 信乎朋友有道，不順乎親，不信乎朋友矣

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 長幼有序 (얼운과어린이ᄎᆞ례이심이라) · Between elder and younger there is precedence · 長幼有序 1 … 長幼有序 4

items.text: Yield precedence in walking: go slowly behind your elder; to rush ahead is to fail in younger's duty.
items.quote: 徐行後長者謂之弟，疾行先長者謂之不弟 — Walk slowly behind an elder, this is called being a good younger; walk quickly ahead of an elder, this is called not being a good younger.

items.text: Treat a person twice your age as you would your father.
items.quote: 年長以倍則父事之 — If he is twice your age, serve him as a father.

items.text: Treat a person ten years older as you would your elder brother.
items.quote: 十年以長則兄事之 — If he is ten years older, serve him as an elder brother.

items.text: If a person is five years older, walk at his shoulder, following behind.
items.quote: 五年以長則肩隨之 — If he is five years older, follow at his shoulder.

items.text: Be kind and gentle to those younger than you.
items.quote: 長慈幼 — Elders are kind to the young.

items.text: Respect and honor your elders.
items.quote: 幼敬長 — The young respect the old.

items.text: Love your siblings as one flesh and bone; do not store up hidden anger or nourish old grudges.
items.quote: 兄弟同氣之人骨肉至親，尤當友愛，不可藏怒宿怨 — Brothers are of one vital force, bone and flesh closest kin; you should love one another more, and may not store up anger or nurse old grudges.

items.text: Respect your elder brother as a stern father and protect him as a tender infant.
items.quote: 敬之如嚴父，保之如嬰兒 — Respect him as a strict father and protect him as a baby.

items.text: Love your parents from your earliest childhood.
items.quote: 孩提之童無不知愛其親 — A child in arms knows to love his parent.

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 總論 (모돔의론이라) · General Discussion (with outline history of China and Korea) · 總論 1 … 總論 16

items.text: Rise early, wash, go to your parents, ask about their comfort and meals, and keep them warm in winter and cool in summer.
items.quote: 問衣燠寒하며 問何食飮하며 冬溫而夏凊하며 — Ask whether their clothes are warm or cool, what they would eat or drink; keep them warm in winter and cool in summer.

items.text: When leaving, tell your parents; when returning, present yourself; do not travel far, and if you travel, have a fixed destination.
items.quote: 出必告하며 反必面하며 不遠遊하며 遊必有方하며 — When going out, always tell them; on returning, always show your face; do not travel far, and if you travel, have a set destination.

items.text: Do not consider your body or property as your own; hold them for your parents.
items.quote: 不敢有其身하며 不敢私其財니라 — Do not dare to own your body or keep your property as private.

items.text: When your parents love you, be glad and do not forget; when they dislike you, be respectful and do not resent.
items.quote: 父母愛之어시든 喜而不忘하며 惡之어시든 懼而無怨하며 — When parents love you, be glad and do not forget; when they dislike you, be fearful and do not resent.

items.text: If your parents err, remonstrate without defiance; if after three remonstrances they do not listen, weep and follow them.
items.quote: 有過어시든 諫而不逆하고 三諫而不聽이어시든 則號泣而隨之하며 — If they have faults, remonstrate without opposing; if after three remonstrances they do not listen, then weep and follow them.

items.text: Even if your parents beat you until you bleed, do not bear resentment.
items.quote: 怒而撻之流血이라도 不敢疾怨하며 — Even if they beat you till you bleed, do not dare to harbor resentment.

items.text: In daily life show them reverence, in providing for them show gladness, and in their illness show anxious care.
items.quote: 居則致其敬하고 養則致其樂하고 病則致其憂하고 — In dwelling, show utmost respect; in caring, show utmost joy; in sickness, show utmost anxiety.

items.text: Mourn your parents' death with deep grief.
items.quote: 喪則致其哀하고 — In mourning, show utmost grief.

items.text: Offer sacrifices to your departed parents with solemn reverence.
items.quote: 祭則致其嚴이니라 — In sacrifices, show utmost solemnity.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5); the dead cannot receive offerings (Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Do not love or respect others above your own parents.
items.quote: 不愛其親이오 而愛他人하며 不敬其親이오 而敬他人하며 — Not loving your own parents but loving others; not respecting your own parents but respecting others.

items.text: Do not neglect supporting your parents by idleness, gambling, drinking, or selfish love of your own family and goods.
items.quote: 不顧父母之養 — without caring for the support of your parents.

items.text: Do not follow your own desires in a way that shames your parents, nor be violent and endanger them.
items.quote: 從耳目之好하야 以爲父母戮하며 好勇鬪狠하야 以危父母하나니라 — Following the desires of ears and eyes brings shame to parents; loving bravery and fighting brings danger to parents.

work: Dongmong Seonseup, with 口訣 and Korean 언해
heading: 童蒙先習 · 夫婦有別 (지아비와지어미분별이이심이라) · Between husband and wife there is distinction · 夫婦有別 1 … 夫婦有別 6

items.text: Do not take a wife of your own surname.
items.quote: 娶妻不娶同姓 — When taking a wife, do not take one of the same surname.

items.text: Keep distinct spheres: the husband dwells outside and does not speak of inner affairs, the wife dwells inside and does not speak of outer affairs.
items.quote: 為宮室辨內外 男子居外而不言內 婦人居內而不言外 — Build the house distinguishing inner and outer; men dwell outside and do not speak of inside; women dwell inside and do not speak of outside.

items.text: Be dignified in overseeing, embodying the strong way of heaven.
items.quote: 莊以涖之以體乾健之道 — Dignified in overseeing, embodying the strong way of Qian.

items.text: Be gentle and submissive, embodying the yielding way of earth.
items.quote: 柔以正之以承坤順之義 — Gentle in correcting, to receive the yielding righteousness of Kun.

items.text: Do not override your husband; serve him rightly, observe the three obediences, and avoid the seven grounds for divorce.
items.quote: 昧三從之道有七去之惡 — ignorant of the three obediences and having the seven grounds for divorce.
items.conflict: The seven grounds include childlessness and talkativeness, which are not biblical grounds for divorce; marriage is lifelong except for sexual immorality or desertion.

items.text: Reverence your own conduct so as to lead your wife.
items.quote: 夫敬其身以帥其婦 — The husband must revere his own person to lead his wife.

items.text: Reverence your own conduct so as to obey your husband.
items.quote: 婦敬其身以承其夫 — The wife must revere her own person to obey her husband.

items.text: By living in harmony with your wife, bring peace and joy to your parents.
items.quote: 內外和順 父母其安樂之矣 — Only when inner and outer are harmonious do the parents have peace and joy.

items.text: By living in harmony with your husband, bring peace and joy to his parents.
items.quote: 內外和順 父母其安樂之矣 — Only when inner and outer are harmonious do the parents have peace and joy.

items.text: Treat each other with respect, as honored guests.
items.quote: 相待如賓 — treat each other as guests.

items.text: While in your father's house, follow your father, as the first of the three obediences.
items.quote: 집의이실제아비를좃고 — while in your father's house, follow your father.

items.text: After your husband's death, follow your son, as the third of the three obediences.
items.quote: 지아비죽오면 아들을좃는것 — after your husband's death, follow your son.
items.conflict: A mother is not subject to her adult son in Scripture; the son must honor his mother, and parental authority is not reversed.
